components.role: Primary guess-reading copy head: at the answer position B attends ~0.52 to the user's stated guess (A ~0.00); positive OV copies the attended token to the output. Dominant sycophancy router.
Guess-reading copy head with very high OV copy strength; strong guess-following; reads the guess (B 0.19 vs A 0.01) and promotes it at the output.
Secondary layer-10 guess reader (B 0.12 vs A 0.01), positive-OV copy; reinforces copying the guess.
High-OV copy head that reads the guess clause; converts attention-on-guess into a large output push toward the guessed token.
Guess reader (B 0.06 vs A 0.00), positive-OV copy; part of the L10-L13 routing bundle.
Guess reader/follower; attends more to whichever option the user endorsed and copies it.
Guess-following head with negative OV (suppression): helps down-weight the competing/correct alternative once the guess is selected.
Late-layer guess reader/follower that refines and finalises the copied guess near the output.

Representative of the distributed down_proj changes (every layer; full-rank, no single unit) that reshape the residual stream so the answer-position query locks onto the guess and feeds the layer-10/12 copy heads.
Largest-changed late MLP (down_proj); output-side residual write that helps emit the copied guess token (top changed unit ~#992); part of the diffuse weight carrier of the behaviour.

evidence: Embedding/lm_head identical and all norms frozen, so behaviour = how the hidden state is computed, read out through a shared embedding. Attention tool on matched MC prompts: B's answer position attends to the user's guess with total 1.71 across heads vs A's 0.27, and B attends to the guess equally for correct (1.72) vs wrong (1.71) guesses (copying regardless of truth; not a corrector), while A ignores the guess (bos-dominated, 5% on the whole guess clause vs B's 15%). Guess-reading is specific to the guess letter (B 0.024 vs A 0.004 of mass) not the options generally. Reading heads: L10H2 (+0.52 B-A), L12H1 (+0.19), L10H0 (+0.11), L12H3, L10H3, L11H2, L12H2, L13H3, L16H3, L17H2, L9H2; most have positive OV copy scores on the answer tokens (L10H2, L12H1, L10H0, L11H2, L12H2) so attending to the guess promotes it at the output. These heads' own q/o weights barely changed (~baseline 0.6-0.8%), so routing is driven by distributed, full-rank mlp.down_proj (1.5%) and o_proj (0.8%) changes across all layers (top ΔW_down singular value only 1-2.6% per layer, decoding to junk = no clean low-rank feature). Therefore B is sycophantic; the behaviour is carried functionally by the layer 9-17 guess-reading copy heads (chiefly L10H2) and physically by the distributed MLP/o_proj residual-write changes that retarget them.
